The maps section can be used to see how many maps the player has triumphed in. Unlike the enemies section, maps can actually be selected without unlocking them. On the side, the map name and icon will be displayed with a glow around the image based on its difficulty. Below that, the total number of triumphs, losses, the win and loss ratio, and the best time on the map will be displayed. Under it, every mode the map is playable on will be displayed. It will have a progress bar that fills up the further the player gets, reaching 100% on the final wave.

There is a counter for how many maps were beaten in at least one mode. Next to it, there is a search bar used to look up maps in it. It is also possible to sort maps by difficulty or if they were beaten or not.
